craft_notes: Sthāyin: resolve declared (the thesis). Sanskrit first: thesis (upāya...jāgarūkatā) + fruit (sthitir) → L4 dashes the thesis, periods the fruit. Rows: row 1 (break-last — undivided closes as nirvibhāgā closes). Rupture: dash after awake — method held, fruit stated. Close: end-weight on wholeness. Minimal pass: dash for L3 colon in line 1. Read aloud: this! (dash) whole. Rejected: 'vigilance' — killed: wakefulness plain, vigilance polices; 'unfragmented' — killed: whole sings, fragments analyzes.

lines: The way is this — in self-waking stay awake:
from waking so, the sage stands whole, no part to break.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upeyaprāptyupāyo 'yaṃ svabodhe jāgarūkatā / svabodhajāgarūkatvān nirvibhāgā sthitir muneḥ

reads_against.argmap: The means to the goal is wakefulness in self-awakening; thence the sage stands undivided.
c1_essence: Means: wakefulness in self-awakening; sage stands undivided.
